name: secret-guard
description: Keeps secrets out of the conversation: refuses shell commands that spell out a key or token, and masks secrets in tool results before Claude and the transcript get them

blockCommands.title: Refuse shell commands that spell out a secret
blockCommands.description: Refuse a Bash or PowerShell command that has a key or token written into it, so the value is read inside the command (an environment variable, a file, a password manager) instead

maskOutput.title: Mask secrets in tool results
maskOutput.description: Replace keys, tokens and passwords in what a tool returns with ••• before Claude reads it and before it is written to the transcript

notify.title: Say when something was masked
notify.description: Print a dim line in the transcript each time a value was masked, naming its kind and never the value
